fusions.name: Dead Weight
fusions.desc: Pounces up to 5 tiles onto an enemy and hangs your weight on it for 28 damage, plus 6% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and strips 15% of its armour for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Mauling
fusions.desc: Mauls a cone 2 tiles long, dealing 8 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 10% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +50%). Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Looming Bulk
fusions.desc: Up to 4 enemies within 4 tiles turn on you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Coat
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
